queries.text:
INSERT INTO accounts (name, opened_on, settings) VALUES (?, ?, ?)
RETURNING id, name, archived, opened_on, settings
queries.name: OpenAccount

queries.text: SELECT id, name, archived, opened_on, settings FROM accounts WHERE id = ?
queries.name: GetAccount

queries.text: SELECT id, name, archived, opened_on, settings FROM accounts WHERE name = ?1
queries.name: GetAccountByName

queries.text: UPDATE accounts SET archived = TRUE WHERE id = ? AND NOT archived
queries.name: ArchiveAccount

queries.text: SELECT archived FROM accounts WHERE id = ?
queries.name: IsArchived

queries.text: SELECT id, name, archived, opened_on, settings FROM accounts ORDER BY name
queries.name: ListAccounts

queries.text: SELECT id, name, archived, opened_on, settings FROM accounts WHERE id IN (/*SLICE:ids*/?) ORDER BY id
queries.name: ListAccountsByIds

queries.text:
INSERT INTO entries (account_id, amount_cents, rate, memo, receipt)
VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
queries.name: Book

queries.text:
INSERT INTO entries (account_id, amount_cents, memo) VALUES (?, ?, ?)
RETURNING id
queries.name: BookReturningID

queries.text:
SELECT CAST(coalesce(sum(amount_cents), 0) AS INTEGER) AS balance_cents
FROM entries WHERE account_id = ?
queries.name: Balance

queries.text: SELECT id, account_id, amount_cents, rate, memo, receipt, booked_at FROM entries WHERE account_id = ? ORDER BY id
queries.name: ListEntries

queries.text:
SELECT id FROM entries
WHERE id IN (/*SLICE:ids*/?) AND account_id = ?2
ORDER BY id
queries.name: ListEntryIds
comments: The entries of the account among the ids: a slice, then a numbered parameter.

queries.text:
SELECT memo FROM entries
WHERE memo LIKE ?1 AND (account_id = ?2 OR ?2 = 0)
ORDER BY id
queries.name: ListMemos
comments: Entries with a memo matching the pattern, in the account or every account.

queries.text:
SELECT entries.id, entries.account_id, entries.amount_cents, entries.rate, entries.memo, entries.receipt, entries.booked_at, accounts.id, accounts.name, accounts.archived, accounts.opened_on, accounts.settings
FROM entries JOIN accounts ON accounts.id = entries.account_id
ORDER BY entries.id
queries.name: ListEntriesWithAccount
